title: Terms on the Further Credit Carried by the Building's Maintenance Cover for Each Credited Alarm
content:
# Terms on the Further Credit Carried by the Building's Maintenance Cover for Each Credited Alarm

**Term 1.** Where the building carries a maintenance agreement standing active whose tier includes remote monitoring of covered equipment, a further credit is added for each alarm credited on the plan under the Building Automation Service Plans of that agreement's own annual credit for holding an automation plan, taken over the plan year's included alarm responses.

**Term 2.** Where the building carries a maintenance agreement standing active whose tier does not include remote monitoring of covered equipment, half that further credit is added for each alarm credited.

**Term 3.** In every other case no further credit is added for cover the maintenance agreement carries.

**Term 4.** The further credit is taken to two decimal places.

The agreement, its standing, whether its tier includes remote monitoring of covered equipment and its own annual credit for holding an automation plan are read from the office's records of Preventive Maintenance Agreements written against that building.

| Maintenance agreement at the building standing active | That agreement's tier includes remote monitoring of covered equipment | Further credit for each alarm credited |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | that agreement's own annual credit for holding an automation plan, taken over the plan year's included alarm responses |
| yes | no | half that further credit |
| no | not read | none |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A building carrying an agreement under the Preventive Maintenance Agreements standing active, whose tier includes remote monitoring of covered equipment and whose annual credit for holding an automation plan is 480 USD, on a plan whose tier includes 48 alarm responses a plan year: the further credit is 480 USD taken over 48 responses, that is 10.00 USD for each alarm credited. Where that agreement's tier does not include remote monitoring, it is 5.00 USD for each alarm credited.
